verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵיכֵ֡ן בְנֵי־ מוֹאָב֩ וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן וְעִמָּהֶ֧ם׀ מֵֽהָעַמּוֹנִ֛ים בָּ֣אוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ עַל־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê·ḵên ḇə·nê- mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·‘im·mā·hem mê·hā·‘am·mō·w·nîm bā·’ū lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ
verses.literal: - After this the Moabites . . . and Ammonites . . . together with some of the Meunites came to make war against Jehoshaphat

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָט֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר רָ֛ב הָמ֥וֹן בָּ֣א עָלֶ֜יךָ מֵאֲרָ֑ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיָּ֖ם וְהִנָּם֙ בְּחַֽצְצ֣וֹן תָּמָ֔ר הִ֖יא עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃

verses.literal: Then some men came and told Jehoshaphat . . . A vast army is coming against you from Edom from beyond the Sea they are already vvv in Hazazon-tamar (that is En-gedi . . .

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט אֶת־ וַיִּרָ֕א וַיִּתֵּ֧ן פָּנָ֖יו לִדְר֣וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָא־ צ֖וֹם עַל־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

verses.literal: Jehoshaphat - was alarmed and set his face to seek the LORD And he proclaimed a fast throughout . . . Judah

verses.original: יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ לְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽיְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם בָּ֖אוּ מִכָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hū·ḏāh way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū lə·ḇaq·qêš Yah·weh gam bā·’ū mik·kāl ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: So [the people of] Judah gathered to seek the LORD and indeed they came from all the cities of Judah to seek - Him

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד בִּקְהַ֧ל יְהוּדָ֛ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֖י הַחֲדָשָֽׁה׃ הֶחָצֵ֥ר

verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of the LORD in front of the new courtyard

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ אַתָּֽה־ ה֤וּא הֲלֹ֨א אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְאַתָּ֣ה מוֹשֵׁ֔ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה וּבְיָדְךָ֙ וְאֵ֥ין לְהִתְיַצֵּֽב׃ עִמְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū ’at·tāh- hū hă·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm baš·šā·ma·yim wə·’at·tāh mō·wō·šêl bə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim kō·aḥ ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh ū·ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·’ên lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘im·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: and said O LORD God of our fathers are You . . . not the God who is in heaven and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations Power and might are in Your hand and no one can stand against You

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֣ה הֲלֹ֣א׀ הוֹרַ֙שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵי֙ הַזֹּ֔את הָאָ֣רֶץ מִלִּפְנֵ֖י עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽתִּתְּנָ֗הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ לְזֶ֛רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹֽהַבְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’at·tāh hă·lō hō·w·raš·tā ’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇê haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ mil·lip̄·nê ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl wat·tit·tə·nāh lə·‘ō·w·lām lə·ze·ra‘ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ō·haḇ·ḵā
verses.literal: Our God did You not drive out - the inhabitants of this land before Your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham Your friend

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ־ בָ֑הּ וַיִּבְנ֨וּ לְךָ֧׀ בָּ֛הּ מִקְדָּ֖שׁ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū- ḇāh way·yiḇ·nū lə·ḵā bāh miq·dāš lə·šim·ḵā lê·mōr
verses.literal: They have lived in the land and have built in it a sanctuary for Your Name saying

verses.original: אִם־ רָעָ֗ה תָּב֨וֹא עָלֵ֜ינוּ חֶרֶב֮ שְׁפוֹט֮ וְדֶ֣בֶר וְרָעָב֒ נַֽעַמְדָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֨י הַזֶּה֙ הַבַּ֤יִת וּלְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י שִׁמְךָ֖ הַזֶּ֑ה בַּבַּ֣יִת וְנִזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצָּרָתֵ֖נוּ וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע וְתוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·‘āh tā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lê·nū ḥe·reḇ šə·p̄ō·wṭ wə·ḏe·ḇer wə·rā·‘āḇ na·‘am·ḏāh lip̄·nê haz·zeh hab·ba·yiṯ ū·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kî šim·ḵā haz·zeh bab·ba·yiṯ wə·niz·‘aq ’ê·le·ḵā miṣ·ṣā·rā·ṯê·nū wə·ṯiš·ma‘ wə·ṯō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: If disaster comes upon us whether sword or judgment plague or famine we will stand before this temple and before You for Your Name is in this temple We will cry out to You in our distress and You will hear us and save us

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה הִנֵּה֩ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֨וֹן וּמוֹאָ֜ב וְהַר־ שֵׂעִ֗יר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ נָתַ֤תָּה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָב֣וֹא בָהֶ֔ם בְּבֹאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֛י סָ֥רוּ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א הִשְׁמִידֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ū·mō·w·’āḇ wə·har- śê·‘îr ’ă·šer lō- nā·ṯat·tāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl lā·ḇō·w ḇā·hem bə·ḇō·’ām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim kî sā·rū mê·‘ă·lê·hem wə·lō hiš·mî·ḏūm
verses.literal: And now here are the men of Ammon Moab and Mount Seir whom You did not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt So Israel turned away from them and did not destroy them

verses.original: וְהִ֨נֵּה־ הֵ֔ם גֹּמְלִ֖ים עָלֵ֑ינוּ לָבוֹא֙ לְגָ֣רְשֵׁ֔נוּ מִיְּרֻשָּׁתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֽוֹרַשְׁתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- hêm gō·mə·lîm ‘ā·lê·nū lā·ḇō·w lə·ḡā·rə·šê·nū mî·yə·ruš·šā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·raš·tā·nū
verses.literal: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession that You gave us as an inheritance

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ הֲלֹ֣א תִשְׁפָּט־ בָּ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בָּ֙נוּ֙ כֹּ֔חַ לִ֠פְנֵי הַזֶּ֖ה הָרָ֛ב הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֤א נֵדַע֙ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֥י עֵינֵֽינוּ׃ עָלֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hă·lō ṯiš·pāṭ- bām kî ’ên bā·nū kō·aḥ lip̄·nê haz·zeh hā·rāḇ he·hā·mō·wn hab·bā ‘ā·lê·nū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū lō nê·ḏa‘ mah- na·‘ă·śeh kî ‘ê·nê·nū ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Our God will You not judge them For vvv vvv we are powerless before this vast army that comes against us We do not know what to do but our eyes [are] upon You

verses.original: וְכָ֨ל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה גַּם־ נְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶֽם׃פ טַפָּ֖ם עֹמְדִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl- yə·hū·ḏāh gam- nə·šê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem ṭap·pām ‘ō·mə·ḏîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Meanwhile all [the men] of Judah with their wives and children and little ones were standing before the LORD

verses.original: ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה הָיְתָ֤ה עָלָיו֙ וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֡ל בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֶּן־ בְּ֠נָיָה בֶּן־ יְעִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן־ מַתַּנְיָ֛ה הַלֵּוִ֖י מִן־ אָסָ֑ף בְּנֵ֣י בְּת֖וֹךְ הַקָּהָֽל׃

verses.literal: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah the son of Benaiah the son of Jeiel the son of Mattaniah a Levite from Asaph’s descendants [as he stood] in the midst of the assembly

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַקְשִׁ֤יבוּ כָל־ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֙ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֜ה לָכֶ֗ם אַ֠תֶּם אָמַ֨ר אַל־ תִּֽירְא֤וּ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֙תּוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֨י הַזֶּ֔ה הָרָב֙ הֶהָמ֤וֹן כִּ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה לֹ֥א לָכֶ֛ם כִּ֥י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

verses.literal: And he said Listen all you people of Judah and Jerusalem Listen, King Jehoshaphat This is what the LORD - says Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged because of this vast army for the battle does not belong to you but to God

verses.original: מָחָר֙ רְד֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם הִנָּ֥ם עֹלִ֖ים בְּמַעֲלֵ֣ה הַצִּ֑יץ וּמְצָאתֶ֤ם אֹתָם֙ בְּס֣וֹף הַנַּ֔חַל פְּנֵ֖י מִדְבַּ֥ר יְרוּאֵֽל׃

verses.literal: Tomorrow you are to march down against them You will see them coming up the Ascent of Ziz and you will find them at the end of the valley facing the Wilderness of Jeruel

verses.original: לָכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בָּזֹ֑את הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ עִמְד֡וּ וּרְא֣וּ אֶת־ יְשׁוּעַת֩ יְהוָ֨ה עִמָּכֶ֜ם יְהוּדָ֣ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אַל־ תִּֽירְאוּ֙ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֔תּוּ צְא֣וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם מָחָר֙ וַיהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃

verses.literal: You need not fight this [battle] Take up your positions stand firm and see - the salvation of the LORD on your behalf O Judah and Jerusalem Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged Go out and face them tomorrow for the LORD is with you

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט וַיִּקֹּ֧ד אַפַּ֖יִם אָ֑רְצָה וְכָל־ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֞ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם נָֽפְלוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַיהוָֽה׃

verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat bowed facedown . . . and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down before the LORD to worship Him

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י הַקָּרְחִ֑ים וַיָּקֻ֧מוּ לְהַלֵּ֗ל לַיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּד֖וֹל לְמָֽעְלָה׃ בְּק֥וֹל
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim min- bə·nê haq·qə·hā·ṯîm ū·min- bə·nê haq·qā·rə·ḥîm way·yā·qu·mū lə·hal·lêl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl gā·ḏō·wl lə·mā·‘ə·lāh bə·qō·wl
verses.literal: And the Levites from vvv the Kohathites . . . . . . and Korahites stood up to praise the LORD the God of Israel shouting in a very loud . . . voice

verses.original: בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ וַיֵּצְא֖וּ לְמִדְבַּ֣ר תְּק֑וֹעַ וּבְצֵאתָ֞ם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט עָמַ֣ד וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ שְׁמָע֗וּנִי וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֙ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַאֲמִ֜ינוּ בַּיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ וְתֵ֣אָמֵ֔נוּ הַאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִנְבִיאָ֖יו וְהַצְלִֽיחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇab·bō·qer way·yaš·kî·mū way·yê·ṣə·’ū lə·miḏ·bar tə·qō·w·a‘ ū·ḇə·ṣê·ṯām yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ‘ā·maḏ way·yō·mer šə·mā·‘ū·nî wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·hū·ḏāh yə·rū·šā·lim ha·’ă·mî·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·ṯê·’ā·mê·nū ha·’ă·mî·nū ḇin·ḇî·’āw wə·haṣ·lî·ḥū
verses.literal: Early in the morning they got up and left for the Wilderness of Tekoa As they set out Jehoshaphat stood up and said Hear me O people of Judah and Jerusalem Believe in the LORD your God and you will be upheld believe in His prophets and you will succeed

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַץ֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיַּעֲמֵ֤ד מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְהַדְרַת־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּצֵאת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הֶֽחָל֔וּץ וְאֹֽמְרִים֙ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ’el- hā·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ mə·šō·ră·rîm Yah·weh ū·mə·hal·lîm lə·haḏ·raṯ- qō·ḏeš bə·ṣêṯ lip̄·nê he·ḥā·lūṣ wə·’ō·mə·rîm hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Then [Jehoshaphat] consulted with the people and appointed those who would sing to the LORD and praise the splendor of His holiness As they went out before the army they were singing Give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וּבְעֵת֩ הֵחֵ֨לּוּ בְרִנָּ֜ה וּתְהִלָּ֗ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ נָתַ֣ן מְ֠אָֽרְבִים עַל־ בְּנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן מוֹאָ֧ב וְהַר־ שֵׂעִ֛יר הַבָּאִ֥ים לִֽיהוּדָ֖ה וַיִּנָּגֵֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·‘êṯ hê·ḥêl·lū ḇə·rin·nāh ū·ṯə·hil·lāh Yah·weh nā·ṯan mə·’ā·rə·ḇîm ‘al- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn mō·w·’āḇ wə·har- śê·‘îr hab·bā·’îm lî·hū·ḏāh way·yin·nā·ḡê·p̄ū
verses.literal: The moment they began their shouts and praises the LORD set ambushes against the men of Ammon . . . Moab and Mount Seir who had come against Judah and they were defeated

verses.original: בְּנֵ֨י עַמּ֧וֹן וּמוֹאָ֛ב וַ֠יַּֽעַמְדוּ עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַר־ שֵׂעִ֖יר לְהַחֲרִ֣ים וּלְהַשְׁמִ֑יד וּכְכַלּוֹתָם֙ בְּיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר עָזְר֥וּ לְמַשְׁחִֽית׃ אִישׁ־ בְּרֵעֵ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·mō·w·’āḇ way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê har- śê·‘îr lə·ha·ḥă·rîm ū·lə·haš·mîḏ ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·w·ṯām bə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê śê·‘îr ‘ā·zə·rū lə·maš·ḥîṯ ’îš- bə·rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: The Ammonites . . . and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir devoting them to destruction And when they had finished off the inhabitants of Seir they helped to destroy one another

verses.original: וִֽיהוּדָ֛ה בָּ֥א עַל־ הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה לַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־ הֶ֣הָמ֔וֹן וְהִנָּ֧ם פְּגָרִ֛ים נֹפְלִ֥ים אַ֖רְצָה וְאֵ֥ין פְּלֵיטָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hū·ḏāh bā ‘al- ham·miṣ·peh lam·miḏ·bār way·yip̄·nū ’el- he·hā·mō·wn wə·hin·nām pə·ḡā·rîm nō·p̄ə·lîm ’ar·ṣāh wə·’ên pə·lê·ṭāh
verses.literal: When the men of Judah came to a place overlooking the wilderness they looked for the vast army but there were only corpses lying on the ground no one had escaped

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט וְעַמּוֹ֮ וַיָּבֹ֨א לָבֹ֣ז אֶת־ שְׁלָלָם֒ וַיִּמְצְאוּ֩ וּפְגָרִים֙ בָהֶ֨ם לָרֹ֜ב וּרְכ֤וּשׁ חֲמֻד֔וֹת וּכְלֵ֣י וַיְנַצְּל֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לְאֵ֣ין מַשָּׂ֑א וַיִּֽהְי֞וּ בֹּזְזִ֥ים אֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל שְׁלוֹשָׁ֛ה יָמִ֧ים כִּ֥י רַב־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ wə·‘am·mōw way·yā·ḇō lā·ḇōz ’eṯ- šə·lā·lām way·yim·ṣə·’ū ū·p̄ə·ḡā·rîm ḇā·hem lā·rōḇ ū·rə·ḵūš ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḵə·lê way·naṣ·ṣə·lū lā·hem lə·’ên maś·śā way·yih·yū bō·zə·zîm ’eṯ- haš·šā·lāl šə·lō·wō·šāh yā·mîm kî raḇ- hū
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat and his people went to carry off - the plunder and they found on the bodies - an abundance of goods and valuables . . . - more than they could carry away They were gathering - the plunder for three days because there was so much . . .

verses.original: הָרְבִעִ֗י וּבַיּ֣וֹם נִקְהֲלוּ֙ לְעֵ֣מֶק בְּרָכָ֔ה כִּי־ שָׁ֖ם בֵּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֡ן הַה֛וּא הַמָּק֥וֹם קָֽרְא֞וּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֨ם עֵ֥מֶק בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rə·ḇi·‘î ū·ḇay·yō·wm niq·hă·lū lə·‘ê·meq bə·rā·ḵāh kî- šām bê·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ‘al- kên ha·hū ham·mā·qō·wm qā·rə·’ū ’eṯ- šêm ‘ê·meq bə·rā·ḵāh ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah - where they blessed the LORD Therefore . . . that place is called - - the Valley of Beracah to this day

verses.original: כָּל־ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וַ֠יָּשֻׁבוּ וִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם לָשׁ֥וּב בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׂמְּחָ֥ם מֵֽאוֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim way·yā·šu·ḇū wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ bə·rō·šām lā·šūḇ bə·śim·ḥāh ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim kî- Yah·weh śim·mə·ḥām mê·’ō·wy·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: Then all the men of Judah and Jerusalem - with Jehoshaphat at their head returned joyfully to Jerusalem for the LORD had made them rejoice over their enemies

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל־ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָֽה׃ בִּנְבָלִ֥ים וּבְכִנֹּר֖וֹת וּבַחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū yə·rū·šā·lim ’el- bêṯ Yah·weh bin·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ ū·ḇa·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: So they entered Jerusalem and went into the house of the LORD with harps lyres and trumpets

verses.original: פַּ֣חַד אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיְהִי֙ עַ֖ל כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת בְּשָׁמְעָ֕ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחַ֣ם עִ֖ם אוֹיְבֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·hî ‘al kāl- mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ bə·šā·mə·‘ām kî Yah·weh nil·ḥam ‘im ’ō·wy·ḇê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט מַלְכ֣וּת וַתִּשְׁקֹ֖ט אֱלֹהָ֖יו וַיָּ֧נַֽח ל֦וֹ מִסָּבִֽיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ mal·ḵūṯ wat·tiš·qōṭ ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yā·naḥ lōw mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat’s kingdom was at peace for his God had given him rest on every side

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה שְׁלֹשִׁים֩ וְחָמֵ֨שׁ בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֜ה בְּמָלְכ֗וֹ מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ אִמּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֣ם עֲזוּבָ֖ה בַּת־ שִׁלְחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ way·yim·lōḵ ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh šə·lō·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš ben- šā·nāh bə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh ’im·mōw wə·šêm ‘ă·zū·ḇāh baṯ- šil·ḥî
verses.literal: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah He [was] thirty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five . . . years His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדֶ֛רֶךְ אָבִ֥יו אָסָ֖א וְלֹא־ סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נָּה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ā·ḇîw ’ā·sā wə·lō- sār mim·men·nāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And [Jehoshaphat] walked in the way of his father Asa and did not turn away from it he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD

verses.original: הַבָּמ֖וֹת אַ֥ךְ לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ הָעָם֙ לֹא־ וְע֤וֹד הֵכִ֣ינוּ לְבָבָ֔ם לֵאלֹהֵ֖י אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’aḵ lō- sā·rū hā·‘ām lō- wə·‘ō·wḏ hê·ḵî·nū lə·ḇā·ḇām lê·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: The high places however were not removed the people had not yet set their hearts on the God of their fathers

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בְּדִבְרֵי֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֔נִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֹֽעֲלָ֔ה עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm bə·ḏiḇ·rê yê·hū ḇen- ḥă·nā·nî ’ă·šer hō·‘ă·lāh ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat from beginning to end they are indeed written in the Chronicles of Jehu son of Hanani which are recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵיכֵ֗ן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶתְחַבַּר֙ עִ֖ם אֲחַזְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ הִרְשִׁ֥יעַ
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê·ḵên yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ·ḥab·bar ‘im ’ă·ḥaz·yāh me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl hū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hir·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Later Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel who acted wickedly

verses.original: וַיְחַבְּרֵ֣הוּ עִמּ֔וֹ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֳנִיּ֖וֹת לָלֶ֣כֶת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֳנִיּ֖וֹת בְּעֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥab·bə·rê·hū ‘im·mōw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’o·nî·yō·wṯ lā·le·ḵeṯ tar·šîš way·ya·‘ă·śū ’o·nî·yō·wṯ bə·‘eṣ·yō·wn gā·ḇer
verses.literal: They agreed . . . to make ships to go to Tarshish and these were built . . . vvv in Ezion-geber

verses.original: אֱלִיעֶ֤זֶר בֶּן־ דֹּדָוָ֙הוּ֙ מִמָּ֣רֵשָׁ֔ה וַיִּתְנַבֵּ֞א עַל־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּהִֽתְחַבֶּרְךָ֣ עִם־ אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽת־ פָּרַ֤ץ מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וַיִּשָּׁבְר֣וּ וְלֹ֥א עָצְר֖וּ לָלֶ֥כֶת אֶל־ תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer ben- dō·ḏā·wā·hū mim·mā·rê·šāh way·yiṯ·nab·bê ‘al- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ lê·mōr kə·hiṯ·ḥab·ber·ḵā ‘im- ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū Yah·weh ’eṯ- pā·raṣ ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā ’o·nî·yō·wṯ way·yiš·šā·ḇə·rū wə·lō ‘ā·ṣə·rū lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- tar·šîš
verses.literal: Then Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat saying Because you have allied yourself with Ahaziah the LORD - has destroyed your works So the ships were wrecked vvv and were unable to sail to Tarshish
